thread:
marie_support: Hi team — customer @bob (account acme-42) reports a sudden spike in API latency after the weekend deploy. Console shows region tag `eu-west` for their org, but their serving logs show requests landing in `us-central`. They’re seeing 400–800ms extra RTT and one 5xx. Can we triage?

customer_bob: this is impacting our Checkout flow. sample req id: req_0a1b2c3d. First noticed around 2024-12-08T02:14:00Z. We didn’t change anything on our side.

marie_support: Thanks — can you paste the full curl you used and the `X-Redwood-Region` header if present? Also, do you have any replay logs?

customer_bob: here's the call we make (redacted token):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small", "prompt":"test"}'
```
No explicit region header from our SDK. SDK version 2.4.1.

rohan_eng: looping in infra. Quick guess: smart routing fallback may have sent them to nearest available capacity in us-central during a transient load spike. But console label should reflect serving region — that mismatch is concerning. @ingrid_oncall any recent routing policy rollouts?

ingrid_oncall: ops-bot shows an autoscaler spin-up in eu-west at 02:13Z and a brief capacity pressure at 02:14Z. Fallback policy kick started at 02:14:12Z for a subset of requests -> routed to us-central. ops-bot: ``fallback_reason=capacity_shortfall policy=v2``

ops-bot: alert: fallback_event: {
  "req_id": "req_0a1b2c3d",
  "from_region": "eu-west",
  "to_region": "us-central",
  "reason": "capacity_shortfall",
  "timestamp": "2024-12-08T02:14:12Z"
}

rohan_eng: interesting — looks like the runtime routing executed correctly, but the console UI/metadata pipeline may not have surfaced the fallback for that org. Two potential bugs: 1) console region badge is reading org->preferred_region instead of last-served_region; 2) billing/metrics pipeline might be aggregating by preferred_region and not by serving_region, causing billing display mismatch.

sre_luis: I pulled raw access logs from the serving layer, they show requests with `X-RW-Routed-Region: us-central` for req_0a1b2c3d and p95 latency ~420ms for that interval. I also see one 502 at 02:14:19Z that may be related.

marie_support: customer also reported an auth error earlier: 401 for a different req (req_0a1b2c3e). Could that be from cross-region token verification?

rohan_eng: tokens are validated at the control plane in the region of the control-plane instance. If we route to a different region without a synced cache for the keyset, that could transiently fail. We recently changed token cache TTL in the control plane to 15s (rollout last week) — could be related.

ingrid_oncall: repro plan: 1) replay traffic from req_0a1b2c3d with header `X-Force-Preference: eu-west` to see if routing sticks; 2) simulate load to trigger fallback; 3) watch console UI stream for region badge updates.

rohan_eng: steps for SRE to replay:
```
python replay.py --req-id req_0a1b2c3d --env prod --retries 0 --headers 'X-Force-Preference: eu-west'
```
Please run with trace logging.

ops-bot: note: metric pipeline partition keys: `billing_region = org_preference` and `serving_region = runtime_routed_region`. A join job is scheduled nightly which can mask intra-day differences.

marie_support: Customer impact summary for acme-42: higher latency, one 502, one 401, possible misbilling view in console (they saw eu-west billing while traffic was served from us-central). Suggested immediate action: issue credit for the affected window, mark as P1 until UI fix.

rohan_eng: short-term mitigation: update console to display both `preferred_region` and `last_served_region` and surface a small warning if they diverge. Medium-term: ensure metric/billing jobs account for serving_region in near-real-time and add a `fallback_reason` tag to traces.

marie_support: assigned to rohan for engineering fix, ingrid for oncall mitigation/rollback if needed, luis for logs+replay. I'll keep customer updated and offer a credit.

customer_bob: thanks — appreciate quick triage. please keep me posted. :thumbsup:

rohan_eng: will follow up with a short postmortem and timeline. initial action: patch console component this morning to show `last_served_region` where available.

ingrid_oncall: performed a controlled replay at 02:40Z — confirmed fallback at ~02:41Z under load and console did not update until the nightly join job. Created ticket INF-4721 to add streaming update.

marie_support: updated customer at 09:12 local. They accepted a token credit and asked for the postmortem.

rohan_eng: tracking; will add remediation PR and link here once opened.

sre_luis: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge/1234 (adds `fallback_reason` tag to serving traces).

marie_support: closing loop — customer happy with credit and timeline. Will keep INF-4721 open until console shows live served-region. :white_check_mark:
